essence: Converts from any lower order receivable on the Lord's turning-them-hither; unwound in order: fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.
Vow purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.
Full oblation with vauṣaṭ ends the fire-work.
Old vow-lord retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with fire — thus liṅga-lifting.
Adhivāsa and the rest as before: the convert rejoins the standard sequence.

rasa.justification: Six injunctions, no ornament, no hesitation: the rite stated as what is done, in order, to whom, with what words.

sections.SUMMARY: Converts from any lower order receivable on the Lord's turning-them-hither; unwound in order: fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew. Vow purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā. Full oblation with vauṣaṭ ends the fire-work. Old vow-lord retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with fire — thus liṅga-lifting. Adhivāsa and the rest as before: the convert rejoins the standard sequence. Initiation at will.
sections.FUNCTION: Unwinds the convert step by step, retires his old bond, and admits him to initiation at will.
sections.KEY TERMS: liṅgoddhāra (liṅga-lifting as reclamation); śaktipāta (descent as the only admission); sāmānya-mantra (common mantra as the beginner's vehicle); vrateśvara (old vow-lord dismissed with honors); adhivāsa (consecration-dwelling as return); yatheccham (at-will as the close).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Follows the consecration āhnika: the already-consecrated needed no rite; the convert needs unwinding first.
sections.BOUNDARY: No doctrine argued; the rite is stated, never justified.
sections.EXPLANATION: Whoever the convert was — Vaiṣṇava to southern tantra, vow-taker, even highest-scripture man under a lower guru — the Lord's turning-them-hither admits him, and this is the unwinding: fast, common worship, confession heard, led before the Lord, vow taken and drowned, bathed, sprinkled, purified with gruel and tooth-stick, led blindfolded in, Lord worshipped by common mantra. Then the vow is purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed in mantra, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā, then the full offering with vauṣaṭ. Then the old bond is honorably retired: Vrateśvara invoked, worshipped, told by Śiva's order to be harmless, fed, dismissed — and the fire with him. That is liṅgoddhāra. Adhivāsa and the rest follow as before. Initiation — at will.
